intro.text: Small animals of the island of Patji that sometimes graze on weeds by the shore.

description.text: Deepwalkers hunt them when they come close to the water, and they are so small that a single strike can kill a dozen at once.
Nell sleep beneath roosting Aviar so that nightmaws cannot sense their minds, though a nightmaw's screech can frighten the birds away and leave the sleeping nell exposed.
